prompt.project_info: Photorealistic 9:16 medium-close smartphone mirror selfie in a domestic living room, with clean raw-texture rendering and cyan-purple ambient light.
prompt.main_subject: One original adult woman with muted blue-gray almond-shaped eyes, natural Type-II skin with visible pores, no makeup or lipstick, and a voluminous blonde ponytail with messy texture and soft curtain bangs. She has a natural curvy feminine silhouette, defined clavicles and toned natural posture. Her right hand holds the smartphone and her left hand rests on the sofa cushion. Do not reproduce Sabrina Carpenter or any other public-figure likeness.
prompt.composition_elements: Seat the adult woman on the edge of a dark-gray fabric sofa with knees together and a slight forward lean for the mirror selfie. Use a medium-close 9:16 vertical composition and a neutral closed-mouth analytical gaze directed toward the phone-screen reflection. Dress her in a high-neck sleeveless red-and-blue superhero-inspired bodysuit with matte stretch fabric and a black web-pattern graphic, plus opaque black thigh-high stockings. Include a sunflower-shaped accent pillow, white matte walls, and a custom cyan neon sign reading 'Pinodi' behind her.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Mix soft diffused natural light with the cyan glow of the Pinodi neon sign and secondary purple ambient edge light. Maintain accurate cyan and purple spill on hair and shoulders and consistent reflection behavior between subject and mirror. Keep the atmosphere sleek, analytical and comic-inspired without trademark logos.
prompt.technical_specs: 9:16 vertical medium-close smartphone mirror selfie, 24mm-equivalent focal length, f/1.8, ISO 100, photorealistic 8K-style raw texture, realistic mirror reflection, natural anatomy and hands, no extra text or logos beyond the specified Pinodi sign.
